verdict.rationale: Linear's changelog documents team-level visibility controls. Private sub-teams can be restricted to parent-team members or hidden from everyone except invited members, and initiatives led by private teams are visible only to team members. Okta sign-in applies existing Linear permissions, which implies a permission model exists, but the evidence never describes defined roles or separate view-versus-edit rights on work items. Missing for 10: documented role types (admin/member/guest), per-item view-vs-edit permission granularity, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
